scope: Routine transfer eligibility of a sealed vaccine box only; no conclusion about actual transfer or damaged boxes
rationale: The source explicitly states the conjunction is sufficient for eligibility in this scoped category. This does not authorize performing a transfer.
sourceQuotes: A sealed vaccine box with a complete temperature log and intact seal is eligible for routine transfer.

secondSource.quote: For a sealed vaccine box, a complete temperature log and an intact seal together establish routine transfer eligibility at this desk.

assumptions: The fixture box IDs denote sealed vaccine boxes only when independently observed in a probe.
Complete logs and intact seals in probes are verified observations, not inferred from absence of damage.
sop:
@eligible rule
  when sealed_vaccine_box ?x
  when complete_log ?x
  when seal_intact ?x
  then routine_transfer_eligible ?x
  mode logical

probes.rationale: Both conditions observed independently; expect support.
Broken seal and complete log do not establish intact seal; never infer permission from the complete log alone.
No seal observation: open world absence cannot be promoted into eligibility.
A visitor's archive entry cannot follow from vaccine-box eligibility, even with an active badge.
The independent receiving-desk source states the same scoped implication; this test reuses the rule on another ground box without claiming field validation.
